+unreleased
+^^^^^^^^^^
+
+- Fix: Make ``JSONStorage`` writes atomic. The new data is now written to a
+  temporary file in the same directory, which then replaces the database
+  file, so an interrupted write (e.g. when the process dies or the disk is
+  full) no longer leaves a half-written, unreadable database file behind.
+  This requires write access to the directory that contains the database
+  file. The database file is no longer kept open between reads and writes,
+  so every read sees the file's current version.
+
 v4.9.0 (2026-08-06)
 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

+def _fsync_directory(path: str) -> None:
+    """
+    Flush a directory's entries to disk, e.g. to make a rename durable.
+
+    This is done on a best-effort basis as not all platforms and file systems
+    support it (on Windows, directories can't be opened, for example).
+
+    :param path: The directory to flush.
+    """
+    with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
+        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY)
+        try:
+            os.fsync(fd)
+        finally:
+            os.close(fd)
+
